legal_context: Royal Charter body; registered charity; statutory National Lottery distributor
legal_power_basis: Royal Charter; National Lottery etc. Act 1993 s23(1)(a); Charities Act 2006 s70
money_in: Taxpayer funding normally provided by DCMS as Grant-in-Aid under s70 Charities Act 2006; National Lottery money is a legally separate stream.
decision_authority: National Council governs. Chief Executive is appointed by National Council subject to Secretary of State approval.
appointment_routes: Secretary of State appoints Chair and non-executive National Council members except London Area Chair; Mayor of London appoints London Area Chair subject to Secretary of State approval. Secretary of State can remove specified appointees with cause.
scrutiny_accountability: DCMS Principal Accounting Officer is accountable to Parliament for Grant-in-Aid; framework requires reporting, audit, management information and compliance with Managing Public Money. Grant-in-Aid is normally drawn monthly on evidence of need and undrawn year-end Grant-in-Aid lapses.
evidence_limit: Framework does not itself convey legal powers; it records legal origins and the operating/accountability relationship.
